payload.title: notification-service is the only business subgraph that does not register VerifiedUserAssertionMiddleware, so its TenantGuard sees no user and every authenticated operation (unreadNotificationCount, list, mark-read) answers UNAUTHENTICATED
evidence: apps/notification-service/src/app.module.ts:324 (configure(): Strip, Correlation, RequestContext, UserContext, TenantContext, no VerifiedUserAssertionMiddleware)
libs/backend-common/src/guards/tenant.guard.ts:65 (throws when no verified user reached it)
payload.rule_violated: Every GraphQL subgraph resolves the caller from the gateway-signed verified-user assertion
payload.notes: Fixed + tests/invariants/subgraph-verified-user-middleware.spec.ts (AST scan of every app.module.ts that registers a GraphQLModule).
narrative: Production 2026-10-26: GlobalExceptionFilter logs 'UnauthorizedException: Authentication context is required. No verified user reached the tenant guard' for unreadNotificationCount, while me() with the same token succeeds.
